Review Diagnostic Report

1. Summary of Reviews
The dialogue tracked the paper's main claims, supporting evidence, and open risks. The paper proposes Adaptive Entropy-aware Optimization (AEO), a new framework for robust multimodal Open-set Test-time Adaptation (OSTTA) to handle distribution shifts. The AEO method uses adaptive weights and entropy-based optimization to amplify entropy differences between known and unknown samples, enhancing detection of unknown classes. AEO significantly improves unknown detection and robust performance across diverse tasks and modalities compared to baseline methods that lead to poorer performance.

2. Key Strengths
